checks.text: On Today the page shows the heading "Hebrew Calendar", "17 Kislev 5787", "Friday, 27 November 2026" and Hanukkah day 1 in 8 days.
On Convert, 27 November 2026 shows 17 Kislev 5787, and ticking After sunset shows 18 Kislev 5787.
Hebrew 1 Tishrei 5787 converts to Saturday, 12 September 2026; 30 Tevet 5787 shows an error that Tevet has 29 days; year 6001 is rejected.
The month list includes Adar I and Adar II only in leap years (5787 yes, 5786 no).
Calendar shows Kislev 5787 with a Hanukkah day 1 cell, Next moves to Tevet 5787, and the Gregorian month view shows November 2026.
Anniversaries lists three fictional seed records and lets a record be added and deleted.
Year shows Rosh Hashana on Saturday, 12 September 2026 and a leap year for 5787.
The Israel/Diaspora choice persists after reload and changes the Simchat Torah rows.
